# Dom Pedro Ghoul Bounty Hunter Build

![Dom Pedro Ghoul Bounty Hunter Build](/uploads/686_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Play Style:** Ghoul | V.A.T.S. | Critical Hits | crippling | High DPS | No sneak

This build is a bounty hunter ghoul that doesn't hide. He doesn't rely on a stealth bonus, but rather on adrenaline and a quick finger on the trigger. The **Primary Weapon is Dom Pedro** the Ghoul Revolver, which you received in Season 23. If you don't have it yet, you can buy it with all of Windy's mods in Highway Town.

The build uses VATS and achieves very good critical hit damage through high weak point damage. Even with a bonus for cripple, the build works via the perk cards. Adrenaline gives another bonus in events for more damage and a faster finger. But even without VATS you can use Dom Pedro to keep your opponents at bay.

### Base: Ghoul Glow & Non-Wild

In this build we make sure that our Ghoul **Glow** (green life bar on the TP bar) is as full as possible. If the glow decreases, we use poisonous water or poisonous slime. You should always have enough of these with you and make them available on your speed bike. You can get poisonous water in many places, e.g. at the Blackwater Mine, Radiant Hills, Toxic Valley, etc. You can get toxic slime in West Tek and in small doses from the slime cooler (reward of this season 20).

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-glow-bar.png)

It is also important to **not go wild**. Ferocity is represented by the bar above the AP bar at the bottom right. The fuller the bar, the less wild you are. The bar should therefore always be as full as possible. This can be achieved through **Chems** and "The Fix", although we currently only get a couple of them in the Ghoul Quest. Tip: Psychobuff fills a lot of the bar.

In this build, however, we use the legendary perk "Action Diet" to always be lucid even without constant use of chems.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-feral-bar.png)

## Equipment

### Weapons

The bounty hunter Ghoul uses 2 Dom Pedro revolvers. A quick one for events and one as a rifle variant for more bonuses against bosses and at a distance. Both variants are played with Rasend (for the reverse rush mechanic) and with improved VATS on the 2* legendary mod. The 2* improves the precision enormously and is absolutely recommended on Dom Pedro.

![Dom Pedro Revolver](/uploads/skywalka55-fallout76-20260412-21-34-37.jpg) 

Due to the increased reload speed of the magazine and the legendary 3* mod, as well as the 4* The Adventurer (which you can get from Bigfoot on a weapon), the rate of fire and reload speed increase enormously as soon as more than 10 enemies have been killed. At the same time, the Dom Pedro revolver in this version still deals more than enough damage and is therefore very playable. Whether you prefer the .308 premium bolt or the .308 high-velocity bolt is a matter of taste. Both work very well.

![Dom Pedro Rifle](/uploads/skywalka55-fallout76-20260412-21-34-45.jpg) 

The rifle variant has a little more precision. To be fair, it must be said that Dom Pedro is in no way a surgeon's scalpel. At times he hits very well, then there are situations where he hits quite poorly. Probably also server-dependent and possibly the problem of one or two bugs. If you don't hit, deactivate the VATS and activate it again, change position slightly or simply shoot briefly with the rear sight.

The rifle is particularly suitable for bosses, as the 4th star "The Bully" is hardly active against smaller opponents (they simply fall over too quickly). With large opponents it is un. thanks to these mods
